note: Chapter 1 keys Messi's header from 'Messi heads', the first touch from 'Julián Álvarez', the carry from 'from near halfway' / 'He charges' and the goal on 'he scores'. Chapter 2 keys the first bounce on 'bounces off him' and the second on 'bounces back'. Read 'Álvarez' as AL-va-res, 'Juranović' as yoo-RAH-no-vich, 'Livaković' as lee-VAH-ko-vich, 'Lusail' as loo-SAIL.

chapters.label: The run, live
chapters.text: Qatar, 2022, the World Cup semi-final. Messi heads it on, and Julián Álvarez is off, from near halfway! He charges at Croatia's defenders... and he scores!

chapters.label: Lucky bounces
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Juranović tackles, but the ball bounces off him and runs on. Sosa tries to clear it, and it bounces back to Álvarez!

chapters.label: The finish
chapters.text: Right foot, close range, past Livaković. Two-nil to Argentina! They went on to reach the final.

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: when you have space, drive forward with the ball. Stay strong when tackles come in, and keep going until the end!
